They did it! @apple finally did it! There’s now a touchscreen on the Apple MacBook Pro, which they call “PROLED.” Clever, clever, hehe. Now it’s clear that the big hype is around the touchscreen, but there are many other reasons that make the new Apple MacBook Pro with PROLED display worth considering. There’s that new, beautiful, insanely bright, ridiculously high-contrast tandem OLED display, that looks incredible. There’s a 14” model that I got is half a pound lighter and slightly thinner, which is amazing for all the travel I go on, and yes, the Apple logo finally illuminated again! I think silver is the go-to color now that the glowing apple is back. They also tuned the speakers differently, so it emphasizes bass a bit more, which some may like, and you can get the same performance and battery life as the non touchscreen Mac, but you get all these nice improvements for only $400 more. That’s not a bad deal!! I also got the nanotexture on mine, and I have zero regrets. Easily the way to go for me with all the travel I’m doing. It just feels better on my eyes, I don’t struggle with reflections, and it’s even smoother for touch. What do you think about the new Apple MacBook Pro with PROLED Display? Would you get it? Are you upgrading from an older Mac, and which one? Or would this be your first Mac? I’m super curious.
